div.class: o_multi_image_box position-relative d-inline-block rounded-3 border bg-white shadow-sm overflow-hidden

img.t-att-title: hasImage(state.currentSlot) ? 'Image ' + state.currentSlot + ' of 4' : 'Click to upload image ' + state.currentSlot

div.class: position-absolute top-0 end-0 m-1 px-1 rounded-pill text-white fw-bold d-flex align-items-center
div.style: background: rgba(33, 37, 41, 0.7); font-size: 9px; line-height: 14px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2;

button.class: btn btn-sm position-absolute top-50 start-0 translate-middle-y p-0 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center shadow-sm
button.style: width: 18px; height: 26px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-left: none; z-index: 3;
button.title: Previous image (slot)

button.class: btn btn-sm position-absolute top-50 end-0 translate-middle-y p-0 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center shadow-sm
button.style: width: 18px; height: 26px; border-radius: 4px 0 0 4px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-right: none; z-index: 3;
button.title: Next image (slot)

div.class: position-absolute bottom-0 start-0 w-100 d-flex flex-column align-items-center pb-1 pt-2
div.style: background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 60%, transparent 100%); z-index: 2;

span.style: width: 6px; height: 6px; display: inline-block; cursor: pointer;

button.class: btn btn-sm btn-primary p-0 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center shadow-sm border-0
button.title: Upload images (select 1 to 4 files)

button.class: btn btn-sm btn-danger p-0 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center shadow-sm border-0
button.title: Delete this image
